stemMd: A team completes 2/5 of a project on Monday and 1/3 of the remaining work on Tuesday. What fraction of the whole project remains?
explanationMd: After Monday, 3/5 remains. Tuesday leaves two thirds of that amount, giving (2/3)(3/5)=2/5 of the whole project.

distractorRationale.a: This is Tuesday's completed fraction of the whole, not what remains.
distractorRationale.e: This is the fraction of Monday's remainder left, not of the whole.
distractorRationale.b: This treats Tuesday's fraction as a fraction of the whole.
distractorRationale.d: This is what remained after Monday only.
